name: Hub accounts
description: For apps behind axHub's sign-in wall: the role comes from the signed-in hub account, not a picker. Hub admins get admin; a hub user an admin granted the app's themes permission (<app>.themes, e.g. console.themes) gets themes; every other hub user gets user. The server enforces the same split.
author: AmberX AXF

permissions.assets.swap: Change themes, colours, layouts and style
permissions.dev.tools: Build and open the developer console

roles.label: Admin
roles.description: Hub admin: everything, plus account management on the hub.

roles.label: User (themes allowed)
roles.description: Hub user granted <app>.themes: may change themes, colours, layouts and style.

roles.label: User
roles.description: Hub user: looks around; more only when an admin grants it on the hub.
